title: The decisions screen shows where a derived answer was read from, each decision's category, and filters by them
name: decisions-derived
description: apps/dashboard/src/decisions/Decisions.tsx already lists every decision with the chosen option, the options not picked and the bound nodes. A derived answer is only a faint 'derived' word whose source is in a hover `title`, and the category is not shown. Show the source inline ('read off: <path>'), show the category, and add a filter: all / open / answered / derived. Tests in data.test.ts for the filter.

brief.approach: Keep decisionRows in apps/dashboard/src/decisions/data.ts as the existing projection and add a small `filterDecisionRows(rows, filter)` helper for all/open/answered/derived, where derived means an answered row with non-null answer.derived. In apps/dashboard/src/decisions/Decisions.tsx add a labelled four-option filter control backed by useState; apply it to the projected rows while keeping the total and open counts based on all rows. Show row.category near its state and replace the faint hover-only `derived` tag with inline `read off: <source>` text that wraps on narrow screens. Reuse current text styles and keyboard-accessible native buttons/select. Add cases to apps/dashboard/src/decisions/data.test.ts for every filter and derived provenance; avoid changes outside the decisions screen.

acceptance.proves: All/open/answered/derived filters select the right rows and retain the answer source.

acceptance.run: pnpm exec biome check apps/dashboard/src/decisions && pnpm --filter @besober/dashboard build
acceptance.proves: Decision screen code passes style checks and dashboard compilation.

plain.what: Show each decision's category and derived source directly, and add four filters to the decisions screen.
plain.why: The source is currently hidden in a hover hint, and the list cannot be narrowed by state.
plain.check: Run only decision data tests, then dashboard style and build checks.
plain.risk: Small screen text may wrap; the source remains visible and the filter uses a native control.
